causalLimits: Perfect TRAIN + weak development establishes transfer failure after optimization; it does not isolate embedding, pooling, head or data as the sole cause.
Common last-token Qwen vector and learned shared projection are one fixed representation; no native ablation was run in this review.
20 background blocks,2 query strings,4 color lists and correlated histories leave substantial shortcut opportunities.
Semantic TRAIN diversification and independently varied distracting interests/colors/priorities are better-supported next tests than capacity blame or lowering the gate.
